build_qwen3_causal_lm: build a Qwen3ForCausalLM model with config and quantization config for autoregressive text generation
run_qwen3_forward: run a forward pass on Qwen3ForCausalLM with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch to produce logits
load_qwen3_weights: load trained weights into Qwen3ForCausalLM with stacked parameter mapping for qkv_proj and gate_up_proj shards
set_eagle3_layers_capture: set EAGLE3 auxiliary hidden state capture layers on Qwen3ForCausalLM for speculative decoding
split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope: split qkv output with rmsnorm and rope on NPU using split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope kernel
